tasks.short: Conduct scientific research and publish actual findings.

steps.what: Find and verify actual research literature, study sources and intended publication requirements
inputs: actual research question
actual scholarly sources and journal/book/media requirements
outputs: checked actual research/publication context

steps.what: Conduct actual scientific research, capture measurements, analyse evidence and choose findings and limitations
inputs: checked actual research/publication context
actual field/laboratory/observational data and study methods
outputs: actual checked research results and chosen conclusions/limitations

steps.what: Draft actual research manuscript from verified results and teacher-chosen findings
inputs: actual checked research results and chosen conclusions/limitations
checked actual research/publication context
outputs: source-linked actual research manuscript draft

loop.purpose: Draft variable manuscript prose from actual research results
loop.input: verified results, actual sources and chosen conclusions/limitations
loop.check: Check scientific meaning, every result/citation, uncertainty and omissions; no fabricated data or causal claims
loop.stop: Missing result/source or two failed checks means manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native manuscript fields/templates first; variable research prose alone needs bounded drafting

steps.what: Check complete final manuscript, data/citations, rights, limitations and actual publication route
inputs: source-linked actual research manuscript draft
actual checked research results and chosen conclusions/limitations
outputs: checked final manuscript and authorised submission/publication destinations

steps.what: Save checked final actual research manuscript
inputs: checked final manuscript and authorised submission/publication destinations
outputs: saved actual manuscript

steps.what: Submit exact checked manuscript to actual journal or book publication channel
inputs: checked final manuscript and authorised submission/publication destinations
outputs: actual manuscript submitted; editorial decision pending

steps.what: Publish exact checked findings through actual authorised electronic medium when rights and approvals exist
inputs: checked final manuscript and authorised submission/publication destinations
actual publication rights and required acceptance/permissions
outputs: actual authorised electronic findings publication

tasks.design: Configure native source links in {DATA_PLATFORM} and {DOCS}, then use bounded manuscript prose drafting from actual checked results. Retain all research and complete scientific review before separate save, actual journal/book submission through {PARTNER_PORTAL}, or authorised electronic publication through {CMS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Research publication can repeat source navigation and findings prose.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links and bounded drafting can reduce those repetitions.
tasks.still_hard: Actual research validity and defensible conclusions require scientific work.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises evidence insufficient for a publishable scientific claim.
tasks.altitude: Less manuscript administration; scientific research stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-linked manuscript drafting can assist composition; it does not conduct scientific research or secure editorial acceptance.

assumptions: Actual research team/instruments produce all observations and measurements during retained s2; teacher performs scientific analysis and chooses conclusions. No result is inferred from planned work or free structured capture.

S3 retains 10.5 provisional hours of result clarification/draft checking; s4 retains complete scientific/citation/omission/rights review. All new tables/analysis remain in s2 unless actual repetitive arithmetic is separately established.

Journal/book submission and own electronic publication are alternative routes, not mandatory serial releases; remove unused route and reweight. Editorial acceptance remains editor work. Any revised version returns to complete s4 checking before release; actual permissions/acceptance must exist where required.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Native tools first; existing draft/report functions earn zero saving. Save/submission/publication each retain one percent using existing checking. Shared field data counted once.
unknowns: Which actual manuscript prose and source retrieval repeat?
research_questions: Can drafting reduce composition after complete scientific review?
